title: build draft - reads the build from stdin and keeps the bytes exactly as given (no trailing newline is added)
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D7 and the drafts rows of the other decisions (a just-in-time build is a draft kept in .jitso/drafts/ and validated by code)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-15, drafts; docs/decisions.md D7). With `-` the command reads the build from stdin, at most 64 KiB, and keeps the bytes unchanged: the input below ends without a newline and the draft file ends without one too.
